name: Johns Hopkins University
description: Johns Hopkins University is a private research university in Baltimore, Maryland, founded in 1876 as the first US research university. It is known for medicine and public health, and its schools include the Whiting School of Engineering, the Carey Business School and SAIS in Washington, DC.
whyIncluded: Johns Hopkins set up Johns Hopkins Singapore in 1999 with the National Healthcare Group, for cancer care, research and education. Its medical degree is recognised by the Singapore Medical Council for practice in Singapore.

livingCosts.summary: Johns Hopkins' own estimate for a first-year undergraduate living on campus: housing, meals, transport, books and personal costs for the academic year. Tuition and insurance are extra.
livingCosts.notes: JHU SFS 'Cost and Tuition' 2026-27, on-campus living (freshman): Housing US$13,073; Meals US$8,894; Transportation US$738; personal = Books/Materials US$1,377 + Personal Expenses US$1,606 = US$2,983. Academic year assumed to be 9 months (the page gives annual figures). Krieger graduate off-campus estimate: housing US$12,215, food US$8,488.

programmes.name: BS in Mechanical Engineering (Whiting School of Engineering)
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for Johns Hopkins undergraduates plus the university health insurance, which international students cannot waive, and a one-off matriculation fee. Fees rise each year.
programmes.notes: JHU Student Financial Services 'Cost and Tuition' 2026-27 undergraduate cost of attendance: tuition US$68,670 (Krieger and Whiting, same rate); Matriculation Fee US$500 'one-time only'. Compulsory = JHU student health insurance US$3,624, included because the page says international F-1/J-1 visa holders cannot waive coverage. No other mandatory fees are listed. Not cohort-locked. History (read 2026-10-13) from JHU OIRA Common Data Sets, section G1 (private-institution tuition, same rate for all undergraduates): 2023-2024 CDS, which states 'Provide 2024-2025 academic year costs', tuition US$64,730, required fees US$500 first-year; 2024-2025 CDS, which states 'Provide 2025-2026 academic year costs', tuition US$66,670, required fees US$500 first-year (the matriculation fee). The student health insurance premium for those years was not found, so the rows omit compulsory fees and the current premium applies. JHU's archived catalogues remain blocked to automated reading.

programmes.name: MSE in Mechanical Engineering (Whiting School of Engineering)
programmes.summary: Yearly full-time tuition for Whiting School of Engineering master's students plus a one-off matriculation fee. Health insurance not included; fees rise each year.
programmes.notes: JHU Academic Catalogue 'Tuition, Fees, and Cost of Attendance' 2026-27 (also as tuition-fees.pdf): Whiting School of Engineering 'Full-Time Graduate/PhD US$68,670' a year; Matriculation Fee US$500 one-off. No other mandatory fee is itemised. Health insurance excluded: JHU states that F-1/J-1 undergraduates cannot waive the university plan, but no equivalent statement was found for graduate students, and the graduate premium differs between JHU pages (US$3,624 in the catalogue, US$3,936 on the Krieger graduate cost page). JHU's archived catalogues are blocked to automated reading. Duration typical (full-time, up to two years). Retried 2026-10-13: the school's own cost page shows 2026-27 only, JHU catalogue archives (e-catalogue.jhu.edu/archive/...) are blocked to automated reading, and the JHU Common Data Set covers undergraduates only, so 2024 and 2025 remain unfilled. 2025 row (2026-10-13, rung 2): JHU Applied Mathematics and Statistics' own MSE page (not yet updated) states 'Tuition $66,670 annually / $33,335 per semester' beside application deadlines of 15 Sept 2025 for spring 2026 and 15 Jan 2026 for fall 2026, so it is the 2025-26 Whiting full-time graduate rate (the Civil and Systems Engineering MSE page shows the same figure; the ME department page gives '2026-2027 Tuition is $68,670'). AdmissionSight (18 May 2025) and Orbit (citing JHU's Common Data Set) state US$66,670 as JHU's 2025-26 full-time tuition. Tuition only; the matriculation fee was not stated for that year.

programmes.name: MSN Entry into Nursing (School of Nursing)
programmes.summary: Tuition for the first year (fall, spring and summer terms) of the four-term nursing master's for non-nurses, plus the health services fee. The fourth term is extra. Health insurance not included.
programmes.notes: JHU School of Nursing cost sheet '26-27 MEN New F26' (MSN Entry into Nursing, Fall 2026 start), linked from nursing.jhu.edu/admissions/tuition-fees: tuition US$28,000 per term for Fall 26, Spring 27 and Summer 27 = US$84,000; Health Services Fee US$950 for the year; Matriculation Fee US$500. The catalogue lists 'Full-time MSN-Entry to Practice (4 semesters) US$84,000'. Health insurance US$3,293 excluded (the sheet says the university plan is optional). The school expects a 2-3% increase each year. International applicants' eligibility not separately checked. History (read 2026-10-13): School of Nursing cost sheet '25-26 MEN New FA25' (Fall 2025 start): tuition US$23,940 x 3 terms (Fall 25, Spring 26, Summer 26) = US$71,820; Health Services Fee US$300 x 3 = US$900; Matriculation Fee US$500. 2024 left unfilled: no new-student Fall 2024 sheet was reachable; the '24-25 MEN Cont SP24' continuing-student sheet (US$70,428 for Fall 24-Summer 25) is for an earlier cohort, so it was not used. JHU's archived catalogues remain blocked to automated reading. Retried 2026-10-13 (round 3): guessed addresses for a '24-25 MEN New' Fall 2024 cost sheet under nursing.jhu.edu/wp-content/uploads/2024/ all failed.

programmes.name: MD (Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine)
programmes.summary: First-year MD tuition plus the health service, imaging and activity fees. Health and dental insurance not included. Fees rise each year.
programmes.notes: Johns Hopkins School of Medicine Financial Aid 'Cost of Attendance' 2026-2027, M1: Tuition US$69,100; University Health Service Fee US$950 + Imaging Fee US$200 + Student Activity Fee US$250 = US$1,400 compulsory; Matriculation Fee US$740 one-off. Health Insurance Premium US$3,775 and Dental Insurance US$268 excluded (insurance). Tuition is US$69,100 in all four years; the imaging fee is charged in M1-M2 only. JHU's need-based free-tuition support for MD students from families earning under US$300,000 is not reflected here; international eligibility not confirmed. JHU's MD is on the Second Schedule of Singapore's Medical Registration Act. JHU's archived catalogues are blocked to automated reading. Retried 2026-10-13: the school's own cost page shows 2026-27 only, JHU catalogue archives (e-catalogue.jhu.edu/archive/...) are blocked to automated reading, and the JHU Common Data Set covers undergraduates only, so 2024 and 2025 remain unfilled. Retried 2026-10-13 (round 3): MedCMP and CollegeEvaluator give only a 2027 figure (US$71,508), so 2024 and 2025 remain unfilled. 2025 row (2026-10-13, rung 3): AcceptedTogether's JHU School of Medicine guide (published 9 Oct 2025, updated 9 Jan 2026) lists 2025-2026 tuition US$66,580, University Health Service Fee US$900, Student Activity Fee US$250, Imaging Fee US$200 (first two years) and Matriculation Fee US$740 (first year), the same components as the current figure, so compulsory = US$1,350; insurance excluded. 2024 still unfilled.
